title: Stand In Seduction
author: Annie Lauren
content:
Chapter Three 
     
     \"You see, Miss Sanchez, there are a lot of people on the waiting list who would like to invest in my
casino. I could serve you first and I could do that in return for a favour,\" he says and I try not to push him
away. His breath smells like cigarette and it makes me puke. 
     
     \"What favour?\" I ask him. I'll teach this man a lesson once I'm done with my mission and he would never
forget it. 
     
     \"I want to see what you're hiding beneath these clothes,\" he says and licks his lip.
      
     What I thought of him was true. I can't make someone like him have me. For what? I can do anything for
this mission but to give myself to him? Never! I must find a smart way to answer him or else he might
change his mind. 
     
     \"Uh, uh,\" Not that easily Julian,\" I say. \"I want something more than a mere one night stand. I know this
is hasty, but I want more.\" I continue. He looks at me surprised and moves back a bit. 
     
     \"Really? Why would you want to be in a relationship with someone like me?\" He asks me. 
     
     I walk closer to him putting my hand on his shoulders. \"Everything about you intrigues me Mr. Julian. I
want to be yours,\" I say and before he could speak, I crash my lips on his and he returns the kiss. Gosh!
He lips taste like poison. 
     
     As much as he disgusts me, I have to do this if I want to gain his trust and get him wrapped around my
fingers. He begins kissing me roughly, suffocating me. His hand caresses my breasts through my dress
while his other hand caresses my butt. I push him away, breaking away from the kiss. 
     
     \"This is not what I want in a relationship Julian. You must learn to control yourself.\" I say pretending to
be hurt by what he did. I am fuming inside and I want to kick his balls! 
     
     \"I'm sorry...I'm sorry Rosita. I promise that I wont do this again. Don't worry about the investment. I will
make the documents ready.\" He says and holds my hand pulling me to his chest. I can sense the urge in
his voice to have me. 
     
     Forgive me for saying this, but he's so foolish and easily trusts. I thought he would be difficult to
convince but I guess his desire and lust got the better of him. 
     
     \"That's fine Julian. I know that you want me. You're not the only one, but we must not let our desire get
in between our business or else we might both end up...who knows, destructed,\" I say 
     
     He uses his hand to brush my chin. \" You're different from all the girls I've met Rosita. I have never
listened to anyone but today, you have done just that.\" 
     
     I smile and peg his cheek. \"You have also changed my intentions today Julian. I didn't think any man
would sweep me off myfeet in just a night.\" I say.
 
     
     Sometimes I think of it, I should have gone into acting because I've got great acting skills don't you
think? 
     
     \"May I give you a ride home?\" He asks. 
     
     \"No, there's no need. My driver's already outside waiting for me.\" I say smiling to myself. Once I get to
the door, he calls me. 
      
     \"Rosita,\" he says and I turn around. 
     
     \"Any problem?\" I ask him. 
     
     He walks to me andtakes a card from his pocket. \"This is my business card. I would like us to have
dinner tomorrow to finalize the contract. I'll pick you up at 8pm. Give me a call once your done,\" He says
and I nod, taking the card. I intentionally brush my fingers against his. With how close we are standing,
I'm sure he wants to kiss me, but I'm not giving him the chance. 
     
     \"I'll get going Julian. Goodnight,\" I say and exit the room, making sure he doesn't follow me. I breathe
heavily once I get outside. Thank God everything went smoothly. 
     
     Alex is waiting in the car and once he sees me approaching, he gets down and opens the door for me. I
get in the passenger's seat and Alex also gets in the driver's seat. 
     
     \"How did it go?\" He asks, looking at me through the rearview mirror 
     
     \"It went well. Thanks for the tech thing. I think they are hiding their shady deals, so there's hardly you
would find anything suspicious.\" I say to Alex. 
     
     Uncle Max told me that I shouldn't tell Alex about anything I find especially if the casino belongs to the
Marianos. He could get in between my seeking for justice. But I don't think it's right because he is with
me together in this mission and I'm not telling him what I discover. It's like I'm being dishonest. 
     
     \"What about you? Did you find anything?\" I ask him. 
     
     \"I was digging around their systems. They're running some heavy encryption, but I found a vulnerability.
There's a lot of wealthy people involved, Mariana. High-ranking officials, businessmen... they're all in
deep. Looks like they're using Eclipse to launder money and bribe officials. If we can expose it, it could
take down a lot of powerful people. They're hiding a lot of dirty money, and they're using Eclipse to
clean their money and get richer. If we can get proof, it could bring them all down.\" He continues on and
on while driving and I jot them down in my note. 
     
     So the Marianos get their money from this filthy business? I'm sure Diamante Corporation is as corrupt
as Eclipse. 
     
     Our drive to PNP is silent. Alex is not much of a socialite that's why he's not being able to tell me his
feelings. But I'm happy about that because even if he does, he would get no for an answer. Most
importantly, I don't want that to destroy our friendship also. 
     
     Once we arrive, Alex takes the car to the Automobile Sector. I wave him goodbye and I go to my office,
pick my uniform and go to the washroom to change. As much as I don't want to get out of this dress, I
have to. I fold the dress, put it in my bag and tie my hair in a ponytail. 
     
     The best thing about going undercover as a rich person is that you get to wear designer clothes, bags
and shoes and after the mission, you take them for free. 
     
     I go back to my office and put the bag on my desk. I will come for it later after going to Uncle Max's
office. I check my watch and it's 10: 53 pm. He doesn't leave early for home because he is a high
ranking officer. 
     
     He works 12-hour shifts everyday in a week. As a Police General, he is expected to oversee various
aspects of police operations, including strategic planning, personnel management, and crisis response.
This requires a high level of dedication, physical stamina, and mental toughness. 
     
     Does he even get to rest? I feel bad for him. He hardly comes home and he makes me worried.When I
was young, even when he had work to do, he made time to make sure I was never lonely. 
     
     He made sure I never felt like longing for my parent's love because he catered for me and loved me like
he would to his own child. He still does all that and I don't know what I would have done without him.
   
     I knock on his door gently. PNP is almost empty with a few officers behind. 
     
     \"Come in,\" he says and I enter. He's has some stack of files on his desk and he's holding a file,
reviewing it. 
     
     \"Sir,\" I say and salute him. 
     
     \"Oh...Welcome Officer Marian, have a seat.\" He says. \"How did it go?\" He asks me. 
     
     I sit across from my his desk as I recount the events at Eclipse. \"I got in without any issues, sir. My fake
ID got me in without any issues.\" I inform him. 
     
     \"And the game?\" He asks me. 
     
     I take a deep breath. \"Its high-stakes poker, sir. Alex found out from their system that they have some
big players there, locals and foreigners. Eclipse is used for laundering money, but it's difficult to prove
that because they cover up well.\" 
     
     Uncle Max nods thoughtfully. \"What about the layout? Any security systems?\" 
     
     I pull out my notes, laying them on the desk. \"Alex got me access to their main computer. I've got the
blueprints and security feeds here. Looks like they've got a mix of AI-powered cameras and human
guards. I can pinpoint the blind spots if we need to move in.\" 
     
     \"Good work, Marian. What does your gut tell you?\" 
     
     I pause, \"I think they're hiding something big, sir. The players, the security... it's all a bit too tight. We
need to dig deeper.\" 
     
     He nods, \"I agree. We can't just go there, we need evidence. We need to know what's going on inside
Eclipse.\" 
     
     \"Sir, I also discovered that Arnaldo has a son, but he's Braiden's younger step brother which means he
probably married after Braiden's mother died. I proposed an investment plan to him and he would like to
pick me up for dinner to finalize the contract.\" I say ommiting the part where Julian wanted to be
intimate with me. If I tell him, Uncle Max would not make me handle this case anymore. He wants me to
gain their trust, get into a fake relationship with anyone close to the Marianos, yes, but being intimate
with the son of Arnaldo Mariano himself? 
     
     He would go crazy if he finds out, because he thinks these things might make me weak or change my
wanting for justice for my parents. I can do have control over these things but he would not understand
so it's better he doesn't know.
